notes.content:

notes.title: Steam Achievements Published for the v8.50 release! + Broadcast Update
notes.content:
Steam Achievements for My First Date RPG are now published! This v8.50 update, however, does not update the game to unlock the achievements, but you can view them on the Steam store page. Please look forward to the v9.00 update for the game which includes the ability to unlock achievements, along with story five for Elliot and Oriana!

My First Date RPG v9.00 will release and leave Steam Early Access on Sunday, August 18th, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time!

Also, the broadcast date of the Breakthrough Gaming Summer Showcase 2024 has moved to August 17th, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time. We're sorry for the inconvenience.

Thank you for your patience, and for playing during the Early Access period! Stay tuned here and on our website for new version release updates!

Thank you for playing, reading, and watching, and have fun!
